description: Source code for generating protocol type definitions for Playwright, including functions to generate protocol typings for Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox browsers, utilizing external modules like 'path', 'fs', 'node-stream-zip', 'vm', and 'os'.

methods.name: generateProtocol
methods.description: Main function to generate protocol typings based on browser name ('chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit').

methods.name: generateChromiumProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for Chromium protocol by launching a browser instance, navigating to a local URL, extracting protocol JSON, and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: generateWebKitProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for WebKit protocol by reading a JSON file and converting it to TypeScript.

methods.name: jsonToTS
methods.description: Converts JSON protocol description into TypeScript module definitions.

methods.name: typeOfProperty
methods.description: Determines TypeScript type from protocol property definitions.

methods.name: generateFirefoxProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions for Firefox protocol by extracting and parsing protocol JavaScript from a zip archive, then converting to TypeScript.

methods.name: firefoxJSONToTS
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol JSON into TypeScript module definitions.

methods.name: firefoxTypeToString
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol types into TypeScript type strings.
